prompt: Hey, we need a status update for our CTO, Priya. The new e-discovery search index is live and it's fast—under 2 seconds on most queries. But we've got a nasty issue: the date-range filter times out on really large custodial sets, like 100k+ documents. Performance team is still triaging it, no ETA yet. We're at 85% of our Q3 perf targets without that fixed. Also, the new index is using about 1.2TB of storage, which is under the 1.5TB we budgeted, so that's good. The timeout only happens on the biggest matters, but one of our top 10 clients has one of those. We're not asking her to decide anything, just want her to know we're on it. We'll have the triage result by Friday. She reads this before our weekly sync. Can you draft a short status she can skim in a minute? Thanks.

We're behind schedule by 2 weeks because of permitting delays in the older neighborhoods. The mesh network is dropping packets in those areas—about 5% packet loss, which is way above our 1% target. We think it's because of the thick walls and old infrastructure, but we're not sure. We've got a repeater placement plan, but it's awaiting budget approval—$50k for 40 repeaters. We're hoping to get approval next week. We're not asking Ravi to decide anything, just want him to know where we stand. We'll have more data after we test the repeaters in one neighborhood. Can you write a status update for him? He'll read it before the board meeting.

But the field beta units are reporting a firmware crash when the arm encounters a sudden stall. We've seen it on 3 out of 20 beta units. We've got a potential workaround that limits the torque spike, but it reduces responsiveness by 10%. We're not asking Jane to decide anything, just want her to know we're on it. We're aiming to have a fix by the end of the month, but that's tentative. The lab tests are all green, so the sensor itself is solid. Can you draft a status update for her?

We're not asking Marcus to decide anything, just want him to know we're aware and investigating. We've got a temp fix: we put a manual override in that aisle, but it adds 5 minutes per shift.
